account.balanceUnknown: Balance not read yet - use Refresh balance.
account.lead: Sign in with your DeepAI account to let the gateway reach the models. The account key is stored in the gateway database and never leaves this machine.
account.refreshError.http: DeepAI answered with an error, so the balance could not be read. Try again in a moment.
account.refreshError.lane-outdated: DeepAI has retired the version this gateway speaks to it in, so the balance cannot be read. This is a gateway problem, not an account problem.
account.refreshError.machine-required: DeepAI could not identify the machine this gateway runs on, which is what its daily Credits grant is issued against. Set DEEPAI_MACHINE_ID for this host.
account.refreshError.no-account: This account is no longer stored. Sign in again.
account.refreshError.no-key: No DeepAI key is stored for this account. Sign in again.
account.refreshError.rejected: DeepAI refused this account key. Sign in again with a key DeepAI accepts.
account.refreshError.unreachable: Could not reach DeepAI to read the balance. Try again in a moment.
account.removeLine1: This account will be removed from this gateway.
account.removeLine2: Its API keys are deleted and its DeepAI credential is forgotten, so anything using those keys stops working.
account.removeLine3: Usage history is kept. This cannot be undone.
account.sessionNote: This browser's session ends {when}. Logging out ends only this session; the DeepAI account and its keys stay, so other browsers keep working.
account.subtitle: The gateway needs your DeepAI account to reach the models.
account.title: DeepAI account
currency.rateNote: Converted from US dollars at the European Central Bank rate of {when}.
currency.unavailable: The exchange rate could not be loaded, so these amounts are the US dollars the gateway reported.
form.allowedModelsHint: Free models are preselected. Use All models for an unrestricted key; an empty selection allows nothing.

form.tokenLimitHint: Leave empty for no token cap.

keys.copyNow: Copy this key now. It is stored only as a hash and cannot be shown again.

keys.revokeLine1: '{name}' is deleted and stops working immediately.
keys.revokeLine2: This cannot be undone, and anything using this key will need a new one.
